words.example: A thirty-minute Tuesday check is our usual meeting cadence.
words.exampleZh: 每周二三十分钟的碰头，是我们通常的开会节奏。

words.example: Put the biweekly roster meeting on the second and the fourth Monday.
words.exampleZh: 请把双周一次的排班会放在第二个和第四个周一。

words.example: Those fortnightly chats with the clerks will start again in March.
words.exampleZh: 和文员每两周一次的谈话将于三月重新开始。

words.example: Our quarterly all-staff gathering is fixed for the first Wednesday.
words.exampleZh: 我们每季度的全员聚会定在第一个星期三。

words.example: Have the year-end attendance figures ready by the last Friday.
words.exampleZh: 请在最后一个周五之前准备好年底的出勤数字。

words.example: Install the intermediate CA on the portal host or phones will not trust the site.
words.exampleZh: 在门户主机上装好中间证书机构，否则手机不会信任这个站点。

words.example: Our root CA lives offline, and we bring it up only to sign a new intermediate.
words.exampleZh: 我们的根证书机构平时离线，只在签发新中间证书时才开机。

words.example: Send the CSR (Certificate Signing Request) to the team that runs the hospital CA.
words.exampleZh: 把 CSR（证书申请）交给管医院证书机构的那组同事。

words.example: Add the short HIS name as a SAN name or the ward PCs will warn.
words.exampleZh: 把 HIS 短名称加进证书备用名，否则病区电脑会报警。

words.example: The certificate store on the clinic image is missing the new hospital root.
words.exampleZh: 门诊镜像的证书存储里没有新的医院根证书。
